content:
TEMPTATION ||| Slide my fingers across the blade's edge ||| “You think this will intimidate me, Julian?”  
BOUNDARY ||| Hold the blade firmly in my hand ||| “I won’t answer until you clarify the stakes.”  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze unwaveringly ||| “I can't deny that your presence unsettles me.”  
REVERSAL ||| Step closer, lowering my voice ||| “I’ll decide what truth gets revealed here.”  
SILENCE ||| Grip the blade tighter, steadying my breath ||| *Silence*
